findings.fact: External FROM references python:3.11-slim, node:22-alpine, nginx:1.27-alpine lack sha256 digests. Internal backend-shared-base references are not external floating image references.
findings.inference: Candidate Dockerfile base selection does not satisfy inherited contract 09 section 6 item 9 digest pinning. This is a candidate-byte remediation gap; no build outcome is claimed.
findings.repair_path: Pin external base references in additive successor, with exact resolved digest evidence. Supervisor acceptance required before replacing v6.

findings.fact: Workflow frozen install/build uses pnpm-lock.yaml with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; Docker artifact copies package*.json and runs npm ci then npm run build. Both lockfiles exist.
findings.inference: Two different dependency resolution inputs are confirmed; differing installed dependency graphs have NOT been demonstrated. A single package manager is a remediation recommendation, not an explicit contract requirement.
findings.requirement: 09 section 6 items 5,11 require frozen install and reproducibility, not specifically pnpm-only.
findings.repair_owner: Original Stage 1/2 task if changing Docker/lock/workflow; Stage 3 executor if supplying measured equivalence evidence
findings.repair_path: Unify frozen dependency input in successor or demonstrate and bind dependency/build equivalence; preserve historical inputs.

findings.fact: Scan job builds three images into localhost:5001 and scans scan-build-*.outputs.digest. Metadata job independently builds into localhost:5000 using build-*.outputs.digest. Metadata required_evidence enumerates digest-inspection, cosign-verification, attestations; it does not join scan digests/results to artifact digests.
findings.inference: Static workflow does not establish that published metadata's artifact digest is the digest scanned. Actual digest inequality is not established. Local Stage 3 scans of actual built digests can independently supply binding evidence; changing workflow requires successor.
findings.requirement: 09 section 6 item 12 requires vulnerability results bound to artifact digest and candidate.
findings.repair_owner: Original Stage 1/2 task for workflow; Stage 3 executor for independent actual-artifact scan evidence
findings.repair_path: Bind scan result to each final artifact digest, using shared build outputs or explicit equality verification.

findings.fact: required-convergence-check has 13 dependencies and requires success for those 13. core-business-check and e2e-check exist but are not in that list. evidence-validation-check is included.
findings.inference: Workflow's convergence job alone does not prove all Stage 3 gates required remotely. Whether omitted jobs are directly required by remote branch protection/rulesets is unknown; omission alone does not prove remotely bypassable gates. Contract does not mandate every job in a single convergence job.
findings.requirement: 09 section 6 items 2,8 and 15 section 4 require prescribed gates plus exact-SHA remote non-bypassable checks.
findings.repair_owner: Stage 3 remote-readback owner; original Stage 1/2 task only if workflow change is necessary
findings.repair_path: Read actual required checks/rulesets and map each required gate to enforcement; add convergence dependencies only if needed.

findings.fact: Workflow evidence-validation-check executes validator conformance tests. Validator allows UNEXECUTED vocabulary. formal_rc_ready requires all non-promotion records PASS and formal_production_ready requires every record PASS, including later-stage families.
findings.inference: Future-stage UNEXECUTED can make readiness booleans false without alone demonstrating malformed evidence or a Stage 3 circular dependency. Stage 3 actual-manifest validation remains required; conformance tests do not replace it.
findings.repair_path: Report validator structural result, actual Stage 3 evidence completion and later-stage readiness separately; do not fabricate future-stage PASS.

limitations: Read-only static inspection, no build/test execution or remote verification.
Production compose requires image digest environment variables (lines 5,23,46,63,121,193); actual resolved values were not inspected.
No dependency graph comparison, actual digest comparison or runtime behavior claim.
No candidate or product changes; recommendations are not additional contract requirements.
